title: [SYNTHETIC] custom notice from a non-default user is silently never observed
body: [SYNTHETIC -- not real GitHub content; written to exercise inscope_second_pass.py's recovery path in tests] Current behavior: when a workload process running as a non-default user emits a Pebble custom notice, the charm's notice observer never fires -- no log line, no hook run, nothing. Expected behavior: charms should be able to react to a custom notice regardless of which user emitted it.
author: someuser
